metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins for coding guidelines, GitHub Actions conventions, security review, spec-driven development, and a chief-of-staff session for the tmux agent board.

plugins.name: sorah-guides
plugins.description: Coding guidelines and review tools. Skills for general coding, Ruby, Rails (including problem-details errors, protobuf-native APIs, psqldef schemas, Aurora DSQL, running on AWS Lambda, and canonical log lines), Sorbet and Steep typing and adoption, developer toolchain (mise, hk), Rust, Terraform, GitHub Actions workflows, security, git commit style, README writing, and Japanese and English text writing. Includes a security review agent.

plugins.name: sorah-spec
plugins.description: Reviews spec files and conducts exhaustive interview sessions to resolve ambiguities, gaps, and missing details until specs are implementation-ready.

plugins.name: sorah-chief
plugins.description: Chief-of-staff operating manual for a long-running Claude session driving the tmux agent board (sorah-agent-board): keeps agents unblocked, remembers in-flight and parked work, keeps it traceable to Linear and GitHub, and triages inbound without posting on the user's behalf.
